none_means: No qualifying prior reference verified; not a proof of novelty.

problem_class.label: nonconvex
problem_class.details: Unconstrained minimization of a twice continuously differentiable function; convexity is not required. Globally, f(x0)−f(x)≤Δ.

oracle.label: exact_gradient
oracle.details: Every query returns ∇f(x), independently of history and oracle seed. Function values and Hessian evaluations are unavailable.

distinctive_assumptions.label: finite_dimensional
distinctive_assumptions.details: An arbitrary finite-dimensional real inner-product space.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: Globally L-Lipschitz gradient and ρ-Lipschitz Hessian in operator norm, with L>0, ρ≥0, Δ≥0 and ε>0. All parameters, including x0, are public. Allowed algorithms take strictly positive scalar gradient steps and retain the queried point with smallest gradient norm.

accuracy.label: gradient_norm
accuracy.details: The output must satisfy ‖∇f(output)‖≤ε. The output is the best queried iterate by squared gradient norm.

accuracy.label: almost_sure
accuracy.details: Success holds almost surely under the joint algorithm-seed and oracle-seed probability law, within the supplied fixed oracle budget.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: Smooth nonconvex stationarity with a Lipschitz Hessian is classical, but the explicit restriction to positive scalar gradient updates and best queried-iterate output makes this a restricted algorithm-family benchmark.
